name: moodboard-alignment
title_zh: 把客户嘴里的“高级感”翻译成能打勾的审美条目
tagline_zh: 客户说要高级、要电影感，你不知道他到底要什么。它先把这些词转成一页可确认的方向稿，双方点头了才出图——省的是返工，不是时间。
tagline_en: The client says "premium, cinematic, clean" and you have no idea what that means. It converts those words into a one-page direction you both sign off on before any image exists — it saves rework, not time.
desc_en: 审美共识引擎。把客户 brief、会议记录、剧本/故事大纲、品牌/海报/PPT/影视广告/网站 App/游戏等项目中的散乱审美描述，转化为可确认、可执行、可增量修改的文字版情绪板与 HTML 情绪板。
why_zh: 它给自己写了 FAIL FAST：方向没确认就出方案、分镜或 HTML，一律判失败。肯拦住自己的 skill 少见。
why_en: It ships its own FAIL FAST list: emitting option-A/option-B, storyboards or HTML before the direction is confirmed counts as failure. Skills that hold themselves back are rare.
limit_zh: 它强制三段确认（方向稿 → 文档 → 出图），一句话出不了结果，急着要图的人会被它拦住。可以说「不用确认直接生成」跳过，但那样也就没有「共识」这件事了。触发词写死中文审美词。
limit_en: It forces a three-stage handshake (direction → document → render), so you cannot get an image in one message; anyone in a hurry will be blocked. You can say "skip confirmation" — but then the whole point is gone. Its triggers are hardcoded Chinese aesthetic words.
title_en: Turn vague client taste into checkable style specs
limit_brief_zh: 方向没确认它就不出图，急着要图会被拦。
limit_brief_en: No image until the direction is confirmed.
cover_note: 命令：`git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/zhlmi/moodboard-alignment && cd scripts && python3 render.py --data-json ../examples/demo-film/data.json --output out/index-director.html --v`。我造的 demo（其实是作者仓库自带的 examples/demo-film/data.json，不是真实客户素材）
